html:
If you are staying in Nha Trang and planning a trip to Paradise Bay and return to Nha Trang, Vietlook Travel offers a comfortable and flexible round trip private car service with a professional driver.

Paradise Bay is a beautiful coastal area located near Cam Ranh, famous for its crystal clear water, peaceful beaches, and natural scenery. Traveling by private car allows you to enjoy the journey at your own pace and avoid crowded transportation.

Flexible Round Trip Private Car Service

With the Nha Trang to Paradise Bay round trip private car service, you can:

  • Choose your preferred departure time from Nha Trang

  • Travel directly to Paradise Bay without unnecessary stops

  • Request short stops for photos, coffee, or rest along the way

  • Decide how long you want to stay at Paradise Bay

Our driver will wait for you according to your schedule and transfer you back to Nha Trang comfortably.

Comfortable Travel and Scenic Drive

Compared to shared transportation, a private car offers a more relaxing experience, especially for families and small groups.

You will enjoy:

  • Clean and spacious vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Smooth travel along coastal roads

The travel time from Nha Trang to Paradise Bay is approximately one and a half hours each way, depending on traffic conditions.

Professional Driver and Vehicle Options

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced and polite drivers familiar with the route

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles

A baby seat is available free of charge upon request.
